book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 Korin Polho Duichon suraro Korin taun idungma ‘yuha’ yongo bapiya ngo irim togoc

content: Son muyu nakain toroc kiap tanto itongitnung. Nocho wömai Duichon toroc kiap tanto itongitat.
Owiho bigo tau wetwethon matano
Nocho kombihat, son bongono bongono nocha kombingmuya nocho yong fasun mata kanongidotma woroc kokorengga itongidang. Worocha tongga nocho sontha borongdeditat.
Tongo nocho mata au ingoroc kantiwa: Amna ambarachon bigo woi Yesu Duic. O owihon bigo woi opno. O Duichon bigo woi Kopotoroc.
Worocha tongga amna au yu bigo taun weuna dönachu o yong tuctuc mata yontacma yu wömai Duic yangam fap tong imoc imochon yontac.

Wohong owiha wömai nonu ingoroc kombingidamon, owi uyapdecma yu bigo sakemo mangdup tongidang. Yu yangam fapfapno muno. Worocha tongga son kombing tobic tobic owi son dönac yontanganu o yong tuctuc mata yontanganu son muyu bic soni tau weuna yongitnung. Son bic soni matau wei yontanganu wömai sonu op soni yangam fap tong imontang.
Owi au yu bigo mataun weicma, yu woi bigo sakemo mangdup toctocyi simbang entac. O nonu kombiamon kiap ihorocno woi yangam fapfapnobarac. Worocha owi yu muyu bigo tau weuna itongitnung.

Wohong non amna nonu ihoroc muno. Kopotoroc yu amna ino simbang tobigoc. Tuna amna yu Kopotorochon obu irim itmuna yu anggendingitac. Worocha tongga amnaho bigo taun wetwetno maec. Oro owi yu wömai amna yang gendingidang.
Kopotoroc yu amnahon sogida owi tobigoc. Yu owihon docno sogida amna matobigoc.
O ihorocgon Kopotorocho amna tobingga ‘owihon tongfat yecno engoc’ yongo matobigoc. Muno, yu owi tobingga ‘amnahon tongfat yecno engoc’ yongo togoc.
Oro, foro worocha owi yu muyu bigo tau weuna sum yaruho weran woroc angga ingoroc kombiantang: Owi worochon morömo itac. Yu worochon unennegon iditac.
Worochoi oro, Morömaho yangamin wömai owihu o amnahu yui godip tungugon idamoroc. Tongo yu nucno tongfat yeun yeun tongga iditnung.
Boinno, forosicsicnodec wömai Kopotorocho amnahon docno sogida owi tobigoc mahong önga wömai amnaho owihon godibodecma öngkungidang. Owihu o amnahu yu yaityait wömai Kopotorocho tobigoc.
Oro son soni sing mata ngo angsoworearut: Owi au bigo mataun wei Kopotorocha dönac inontacma kiap woroc woi angithu o munohu?
O son soni soworearut, amna au yu bigo sakemo ubarago entacma, woi toroc kiap ogepmaha woha muno. Nocho wömai kombihat, woi toroc kiap ogepma muno.
Wohong owihon bigo sakemo ubarago wömai nocho aaya tongfatfatno ogepma. Woi taun wetwetno simbang idimpac.

Oro amna au yu mata worocha kombiuna angit maidinai wömai nocho ingoroc inontat: Nonu toroc kiap au matanidamon. O ihorocgon Kopotorochon suraro woce woce idangma yuho toroc kiap ihorocnogon tannidang.
Korin suraro yu kumbong imu nocnocha toroc kiap ogepma matongidung

Oro, suran soniho wömai irot tong koing toctochon muno, woi irot tong moin moin toctochon. Nocu woroc angmaina irot ogep makombit. Worocha tongga nocho ‘toroc kiap ingoroc tanto tongitnung’ yongo nongoru kampiwa.

Amna auho ingoroc nanongidang: Son fatmata ogepma kombic kombicha suran tontanganu wömai bonip sonidec irot tungu maiditac. Muno, sonihogon ficfuc tongo torop koböc idang. Oro nocho kombihat, mata woi boinno naning, sum matagon muno.
Nocu kombihat, son ficfuc tongidangmaha tongga amna nongnongo soniot idangma yuho eran öngkuuya yaantamon.
Oro son ‘Morömahon kumbong imu nana’ yongo suran tongidangma woi Morömahon muno.

Sonu amna auha matorengga ididang. Muno, amna tungu tungu inoin inoin nacno yamuc sogida karup karup nongidang. Tongo auho yamuc toup nongga bumbum yongidang. O amna auho nacno yamuc angit maidimuya worec imuya komong ididang.

Son ihoroc tongitninga. Nacno yamuc boyömo nocnocha wömai soniin soniin bucin öngmuya nongitnung. Sonu Kopotorochon suraroha kombiuya yapmu boyömo icha. O son oröc soni nacnoha möp ididangma yuha yangam fap tong imoninga. Mayain nocho toroc kiap soniha tingting sinom kantiwa? Son suraro ogepma sinom ididang! Ihorochu kantiwa? Muno sinom, son suraro ogepma maeng.
Moröma noni yu ihoroc nanuna kantiwa: Yudas yu Yesu Moröma noni ayamphon oburodec sigocan kumbong wocin wömai Yesuho nacno sowarango sogitmuna
Kopotoroc ecec inongga uboda ingoroc yogoc: “Ngoi nochon godip föbna woi sontha tongga urago bogic bogicyi. Tongo son nacno ngoroc nocha kombiu fuduuntho nong tongitnung.”

Oro nacno nongbödeuya yu worochon torocgon wain fait sogitmuna yogoc: “Wain yamuc ngo woi botup botup wegohon. Woi nochon nogotna sontha bogic bogicyi. Son nocha kombiu fuduuntho woroc nong tongitnung.” (Matyu 26:26-28)

Oro mata worocho wömai ingoroc nindahac: Bongono bongono sonu nacno sowarango orin wain yamuc nongitnahinganu wömai sontho Morömaho boinno sinom omong fadocma worochon yong tuctucno tong koing tongidang. Sonu ihoroc tong tongo idiya ino wönggon ehangoc.
Oro, amna auho tong bumbum tongga nacno sowarango orin wain yamuc woroc toroc kiap wontucmunodec naantacma yu wömai turongo moröma tongga Morömahon godip föp orin nogotno tuna sahano entac.

Kombiarut, amna au yu kombiunai kumbong imu nacno orin yamuc woi yapmu sahano, Morömahon godip föbo muno, yuhon matano wömai Kopotorocho yun bödeuna obökangoc. Worocha tongga amna au nacno sowarango orin wain yamuc nocnocha kombinggai yu muyu osuc inoin irot angsoworehun. Angsoworeuna ogep idinai wömai nahun.
Son kumbong imu etno nongidangmaha tongga son bonip sonidecma owi amna koböcmaho obukoc tongga gapgap yongidang. O auho wömai ombung.
Non noniin irot noni angsoworeantamonanu wömai nonu Kopotorocho yangamin nongnongo iditnaya yu uragoha mepmo au manimun.
Wohong Kopotoroc yu turongo noni angga ‘guroc owi amnaot ep böhong ohoningyit’ yongo itonggong noni tobic tobicha mepmo nimongitac.
Worochai oröc ori, son kumbong imu nocnochon suran tontanganu wömai son ‘owi amna ambarac engsuran tongo kondonggon nana’ yongo tongitnung.
Amna au worec imuyai wömai yu böcnon ida nacno nongga epun. Kopotorocho sonthon mata soni yun bödeuna urago kamicyit. Oro, mepmo au sonot idangma woroc wömai nocho sonot engmaina tobiangot.
